page.overview:
Who is Dangō?

Dangō has a short crop of brown hair and black eyes. He wears a pair of circular black glasses.

Dangō advises the Fire Daimyō, sitting nearest to the daimyō out of all his advisers. During an emergency meeting following Pain's assault on Konoha, he vows to provide whatever resources will be needed to rebuild the destroyed village.
